sentences.text: Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. (Oral)
Mr. Rajesh Batra, Advocate with Mr. Hari Mohan Bhatia, Advocate, present for the petitioner.

2. Mr. Rajesh Sharma, learned Brief Holder, present for the State/respondent nos. 1 & 2.
3.
Petitioner is a Company which is engaged, inter alia, in manufacturing of food products.
The proceedings under Section 68 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 is pending before the Adjudicating Officer which is Additional District Magistrate, Haridwar.
The concerned Food Safety Officer has made allegation that there are false claim on the label of the food which is manufactured by the petitioner.
During the course of the proceedings the reports by the Food Analyst and Designated Officer, Food Analyst & Director Referral Laboratory have been asked.

4. The petitioner sought cross-examination of certain authorities, a request which has been only partly allowed as he was allowed to cross-examine one person but the request to cross-examine another person has been declined.

Therefore, on principle it cannot be the case, at this stage,
whether "cross-examination" in these proceedings can at all be allowed as "cross-examination" in at least one case has been allowed.
5.
State counsel has accepted notices for respondent nos. 1 & 2.
6. Issue notices to respondent nos. 3 to 5.
Steps to be taken within one week.
7. State Counsel shall file counter affidavit within three weeks.
Three weeks time thereafter is allowed to the learned counsel for the petitioner to file rejoinder affidavit.

8. List this matter after seven weeks in daily cause list.
